KIRBY_MOD_CARD_KIRBY_STRIKE.title: Strike
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_KIRBY_DEFEND.title: Defend
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_INHALE.title: Inhale
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_INHALE.description:
Apply [gold]Inhaled[/gold] to an enemy.
Gain [gold]Inhaling[/gold]; its effect depends on the enemy's intent.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPIT_STAR.title: Star Spit
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPIT_STAR.description:
Deal damage equal to your [gold]Mouthful[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
Empty your mouth and shuffle [gold]Inhale[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all other Star Spits and Swallows.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SWALLOW.title: Swallow
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DROP_ABILITY.title: Drop Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DROP_ABILITY.description:
Lose your current Copy Ability and [gold]Exhaust[/gold] all cards it gave you.
Put [gold]Inhale[/gold] from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SWORD_ABILITY.title: Sword Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_BOOMERANG_ABILITY.title: Boomerang Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STONE_ABILITY.title: Stone Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FIGHTER_ABILITY.title: Fighter Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_ABILITY.title: Ice Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FIRE_ABILITY.title: Fire Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SLEEP_ABILITY.title: Sleep Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SLASH.title: Slash
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPIN_SLASH.title: Spin Slash
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPIN_SLASH.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Sword[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage per hit.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_RISING_SLASH.title: Rising Slash
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_RISING_SLASH.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Put a [gold]Descending Slash[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Descending Slashes cost 0 this turn.
[gold]Sword[/gold] or [gold]Boomerang[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DESCENDING_SLASH.title: Descending Slash
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MACH_TORNADO.title: Mach Tornado
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MACH_TORNADO.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Sword[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you play a [gold]Sword[/gold] Attack other than Mach Tornado, return this from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_BOOMERANG_THROW.title: Boomerang
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_BOOMERANG_THROW.descripti:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} times.
[gold]Boomerang[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage per hit.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FINAL_CUTTER.title: Final Cutter
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FINAL_CUTTER.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times. Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Boomerang[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage per hit.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_INVINCIBLE_GUARD.title: Invincible Guard
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STONE_PUNCH.title: Stone Punch
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STONE_PUNCH.description:
Deal {ExtraDamage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Buffer[/gold] you have.{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
[gold]Stone[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_CHARGE_UP.title: Charge Up
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_VACUUM_STRIKE.title: Vulcan Jab
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_BREATH.title: Breath
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_BREATH.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Ice[/gold] or [gold]Fire[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_GALAXY_WISH.title: Milky Way Wishes
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_GALAXY_WISH.description:
Whenever you gain a Copy Ability, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Copy Ability cards are no longer [gold]Exhausted[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ABILITY_SHIELD.title: Ability Shield
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MIX_ABILITY.title: Mix Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DEDEDE_INHALE.title: Dedede Inhale
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_FRUIT.title: Ultimate Fruit
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_FRUIT.descriptio: This combat, the first attack an [gold]Inhaled[/gold] enemy makes against you deals 0 (you still gain that much [gold]Mouthful[/gold]).
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_RETURN_TO_DREAM_LAND.desc: Choose 1 of 3 random {IfUpgraded:show:upgraded |}Copy Ability cards and put it into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_META_KNIGHT_AID.title: Helping Hand
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_META_KNIGHT_REVENGE.title: Meta Knight's Revenge
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_META_NIGHTMARE.title: Meta Knightmare
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_META_NIGHTMARE.descriptio:
Your [gold]Sword[/gold] cards cost 0 this turn.
Gain the [gold]Sword[/gold] Copy Ability. Put a [gold]Mach Tornado[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MINE_BATTLE.title: The Great Cave Offensive
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MINE_BATTLE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you have a Copy Ability, drop it ([gold]Inhale[/gold] returns to your Hand) and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPRING_BREEZE.title: Spring Breeze
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SPRING_BREEZE.description:
If you have a Copy Ability, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Otherwise, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STEEL_WING.title: Dynablade
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STEEL_WING.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Turn every Strike in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into a [gold]Peck[/gold] for this combat.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FOUNTAIN_OF_DREAMS.title: Fountain of Dreams
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MIRROR_LABYRINTH.title: Amazing Mirror
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MIRROR_LABYRINTH.descript: If an enemy intends to attack, its attacks this turn deal 0 and it gains that much [gold]Block[/gold] instead.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_BLOCK.title: Ice Block
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_BLOCK_STRIKE.title: Ice Block: Strike
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ICE_BLOCK_GUARD.title: Ice Block: Guard
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_GOOEY_INHALE.title: No-Ability Inhale
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_GOOEY_INHALE.description:
Apply [gold]Inhaled[/gold] to an enemy.
Gain [gold]Inhaling[/gold]; its effect depends on the enemy's intent. Only gives [gold]Mouthful[/gold], never a Copy Ability in your mouth.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_BUBBLE_STORAGE.title: Bubble Storage
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SUPER_ABILITY.title: Super Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SUPER_ABILITY.description: The next {SuperAbilityPower:diff()} Copy Abilities you gain are each gained twice.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SMASH_BROS_KIRBY.title: Smash Bros. Kirby
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SMASH_BROS_KIRBY.descript: Copy Abilities can coexist: gaining a new one no longer removes the others.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STAR_BULLET_BOOST.title: Star Gear
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STAR_BULLET_BOOST.descrip:
[gold]Star Spit[/gold] deals {StarBulletPower:diff()}% more damage.
A Star Spit of {SplashThreshold}+ damage also hits every other enemy.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FORCE_BLAST.title: Force Blast
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FORCE_BLAST.description:
If there is no [gold]Launch[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold], add one to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
[gold]Launches[/gold] in your [gold]Hand[/gold] hit {Hits:diff()} more {Hits:plural:time|times}.
[gold]Fighter[/gold]: they also deal {FighterBonus} more damage.
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_LAUNCH.title: Launch
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SCAN.title: Scan
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SCAN.description:
Apply [gold]Inhaled[/gold] to an enemy.
Gain [gold]Inhaling[/gold]; its effect depends on the enemy's intent.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PLASMA_ABILITY.title: Plasma Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_CAR_KIRBY.title: Carby
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_STAR_ROD_ABILITY.title: Star Rod
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_GALAXIA_ABILITY.title: Galaxia
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PLASMA_CANNON.title: Plasma Cannon
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PLASMA_CANNON.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} times.
[gold]Plasma[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], then gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PLASMA_CHARGE.title: Plasma Charge
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_FLASH.title: Ultimate Flash
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_FLASH.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Plasma[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ROBOBOT.title: Robobot Armor
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ROBOBOT.description:
Gain {AbilityConservationPower:diff()} [gold]Ability Conservation[/gold] and [gold]Robobot Armor[/gold].
Your [gold]Inhale[/gold] becomes [gold]Scan[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_INVINCIBLE_LOLLIPOP.title: Invincible Lollipop
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DODGE.title: Dodge
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_INHALE.title: Hypernova Inhale
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTIMATE_INHALE.descripti:
Apply [gold]Frenzied Inhaled[/gold] to an enemy.
Gain [gold]Inhaling[/gold]; its effect depends on the enemy's intent.
Until your next turn, all damage it deals to you becomes 0.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FEED.title: Feed
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FEED.description: Spend up to {Heal:diff()} [gold]Mouthful[/gold] to heal an ally that much.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ABILITY_OFFERING.title: Ability Offering
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ABILITY_OFFERING.descript: Lose your Copy Ability. Put its Copy Ability card into an ally's [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 for the rest of combat.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FROST.title: Freeze
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FROST.description:
Transform up to {Cards:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]Ice Blocks[/gold].
[gold]Ice[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], and this turn [gold]Ice Blocks[/gold] deal +{IceDamageBonus:diff()} damage and give +{IceBlockBonus:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_FROST.selectionScreenProm: Choose cards to turn into [gold]Ice Blocks[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_KIRBY_FIREBALL.title: Fireball
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTRA_SWORD.title: Ultra Sword
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_ULTRA_SWORD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Vigor[/gold] affects this card {VigorTimes:diff()} times.
[gold]Sword[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DRAGON_STORM.title: Dragon Storm
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DRAGON_STORM.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage. Deals +{ExtraDamage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Burn[/gold] you have.
[gold]Fire[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold]. Afterwards, put [gold]Burns[/gold] from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold] until it is full.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SNOW_BOWL.title: Snow Bowl
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_SNOW_BOWL.description:
Fill your [gold]Hand[/gold] with {IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Ice Block+[/gold]|[gold]Ice Blocks[/gold]}. For the rest of combat, your [gold]Ice Blocks[/gold] deal damage AND give [gold]Block[/gold] without choosing.
[gold]Ice[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold].
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_CURLING_STONE.title: Curling Stone
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_CURLING_STONE.description:
You or an ally loses all [gold]Block[/gold] and gains 1 [gold]Buffer[/gold] for every {BlockPerBuffer:diff()} Block lost. [gold]Exhaust[/gold].
[gold]Stone[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], and it is no longer Exhausted.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PINK_DEMON.title: Pink Demon
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PINK_DEMON.description:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
If you have a Copy Ability, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_DOCTOR_ABILITY.title: Doctor Ability
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MAKE_MEDICINE.title: Make Medicine
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MAKE_MEDICINE.description:
Choose a character. Enemy: apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] or {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] (your choice). You or an ally: remove all [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold].
[gold]Doctor[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MEDICINE_VULNERABLE.title: Vulnerable Dose
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_MEDICINE_WEAK.title: Weak Dose
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PILL_THROW.title: Pill Throw
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_PILL_THROW.description:
Choose a character. Enemy: deal {Damage:diff()} damage. You or an ally: heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
[gold]Doctor[/gold]: [gold]Retain[/gold], [gold]Replay[/gold] 1.
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_EXPERIMENT.title: Experiment
KIRBY_MOD_CARD_EXPERIMENT.description:
Gain [gold]Attending Physician[/gold]. Choose a character (an enemy, an ally or yourself); it becomes your [gold]Test Subject[/gold].
[gold]Doctor[/gold]: costs 1 less, [gold]Retain[/gold].
